# Reporting security vulnerabilities

Your efforts to responsibly disclose your findings are appreciated.

**Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues.**

Use the "Report a vulnerability" button in the [Security tab](../../security/advisories/new) of this repository.

Your report should include:

- MessagePit version
- A vulnerability description
- Reproduction steps (if applicable)
- Any other details you think are likely to be important

You should receive an initial acknowledgement within a few days in most cases.
